entries.label: UNRESOLVED / UNKNOWN
entries.assertion: Тип связи ещё не установлен.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Любой high-burden вывод блокируется; допустима только фиксация co-occurrence/claim.

entries.label: Logical entailment
entries.assertion: B следует из A + формальных посылок.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не причина, не ground, не empirical existence.

entries.label: Definitional / analytic
entries.assertion: B следует из принятого определения/экспликации A.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Явная дефиниция и область её действия.

entries.label: Identity / persistence
entries.assertion: A и B — тот же объект/тип или тот же объект через время.

entries.label: Necessary / sufficient condition
entries.assertion: A необходимо/достаточно для B в указанном домене.

entries.label: Enablement / opportunity
entries.assertion: A делает B доступным/возможным, не определяя B.

entries.label: Causal
entries.assertion: Изменение/интервенция в A изменяет B при causal assumptions.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не semantic, normative или metaphysical ground.

entries.label: Metaphysical grounding
entries.assertion: B имеет место в силу A; claim of explanatory/metaphysical priority.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Отдельный metaphysical bridge; asymmetry/irreflexivity не предполагать без аргумента.

entries.label: Existential / ontological dependence
entries.assertion: A не может существовать (или быть тем, чем является) без B.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не тождественно grounding или logical entailment.

entries.label: Constitution
entries.assertion: A конституирует B при различимости ролей/критериев.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Bearer, identity criteria, persistence conditions, production test.

entries.label: Realization / implementation
entries.assertion: A реализует функцию/свойство B.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Какой role B и каким механизмом A его выполняет; multiple realization check.

entries.label: Supervenience / determination pattern
entries.assertion: Нет A-различия без B-различия.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Указать modal strength и base; проверить symmetry/priority separately.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не объясняет ontological priority сама по себе.

entries.label: Parthood / composition
entries.assertion: A — часть B либо части составляют B.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не group membership или constitution автоматически.

entries.label: Membership / office / status
entries.assertion: A является членом/носителем роли в B.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не parthood и не group agency.

entries.label: Functional role / contribution
entries.assertion: A выполняет функцию F в системе B.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не intrinsic essence, causation или norm by default.

entries.label: Evidential support
entries.assertion: E поддерживает claim C.

entries.label: Justification / reason-giving
entries.assertion: R является основанием для принятия/утверждения/действия.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Epistemic или practical/normative type; accountability route.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не physical cause или ontological ground.

entries.label: Reference / denotation
entries.assertion: Expression/sign S refers to X.

entries.label: Meaning / semantic constraint
entries.assertion: Use/inference/context constrain meaning of S.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Semantic/pragmatic layer; ambiguity and context profile.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не reference или causal grounding automatically.

entries.label: Access / disclosure / manifestation
entries.assertion: A affords/makes manifest B to agent/system.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Access mode, bearer, transformation by access, independent existence kept open.

entries.label: Historical derivation / influence / inheritance
entries.assertion: B derives/revises/quotes/inherits from A.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Provenance chain: source, activity, agent, dates, mediation.

entries.label: Normative obligation / permission
entries.assertion: A bears duty/permission/claim relative to norm N.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: N-status, norm source, standing, affected agents.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не observed regularity or coercive fact.

entries.label: Authorization / authority / legitimacy
entries.assertion: Separate: authorization, de facto authority, normative authority, legitimacy.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Source of authorization; right/power/duty schema; justification of coercion if claimed.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не power, truth or mere obedience.

entries.label: Representation / delegation
entries.assertion: A speaks/acts/decides for constituency B.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Mandate, constituency, scope, revocability, trace, responsiveness.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не leadership, authority or shared intention automatically.

entries.label: Shared agency / coordination
entries.assertion: Agents intentionally coordinate/jointly act.
entries.minimum_bridge_evidence: Joint-action criteria, commitments, plan/interdependence; group-agent test separate.
entries.forbidden_promotion: Не co-presence or collective subject automatically.

entries.label: Power / coercion / domination
entries.assertion: A can shape options/actions of B; coercion/domination are stricter subtypes.

entries.label: Statistical / probabilistic association
entries.assertion: Variables/cases covary probabilistically.

entries.label: Robustness / convergence
entries.assertion: Independent models/routes yield same result R.

entries.label: Temporal succession / persistence relation
entries.assertion: A precedes, overlaps, continues into B.
